summary_claims.claim: Six principles (benefit, justified/proportionate and reliable/valid, safe/secure/private, human-rights affirming and non-discriminatory, transparent, accountable with ongoing human oversight)
Ministries must report AI use cases and risks annually, publish a list of use cases, and disclose AI use where the public interacts with AI or AI affects decisions about them
Review of the Directive at least every two years by the Associate Deputy Minister, PAD

note: Every field is supported by the stored ontario.ca page: effective 1 Dec 2024 under the Management Board of Cabinet Act. No issue date is given, so date_published null is right. The page footer date (7 Jan 2026) is not tied to an amendment. A search found no amendment; the joint IPC/OHRC principles of January 2026 are separate instruments (already a lead). No duplicate in the register; CA-ON-01 relation is sensible.
